Tibetan Youth Congress hunger strike enters 19th day, seeks UN action on China

The Tibetan Youth Congress's hunger strike has reached its 19th day. Exile Tibetan parliamentarians have joined the protest, which calls on the United Nations to hold China accountable for ethnic unity. The protest specifically targets China's actions.
